data.narrative:
Artimus Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Acome, Shane Mitchell, Nick Kellaris, and Christoph Keplinger. The company has raised $5M+ to date. The relevant comp universe includes 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis is applicable and serves as the primary valuation method. Using the $5M total raised as a proxy for seed-stage enterprise value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $12M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while 10 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filter (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comps) yielded insufficient datapoints for statistical reliability.

The triangulation analysis, supported by the single applicable method, indicates a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median estimate of $12M. Key uncertainties include the limited depth of comparable company data at this stage and the reliance on stage-progression mechanics rather than direct peer benchmarking. Material variables affecting this range include capital efficiency trajectory, technical differentiation within robotics subsectors, and near-term funding environment.
